# UX and Accessibility Checklist: Portfolio Card Consistency

**Purpose**: Review whether the portfolio presentation, interaction, disclosure, and accessibility requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable
**Created**: 2026-09-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are visible-text requirements defined for titles, descriptions, action labels, and mobile disclosure copy in every applicable state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are surface requirements defined for both governed dark brands and brands whose governed presentation is light-first? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are both visible-content variants, description and revealed actions, covered by explicit lower-spacing requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are pointer, keyboard, touch, Escape, focus-exit, pointer-exit, mobile disclosure, zoom, and reduced-motion flows all specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005–FR-008, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK005 Are zero, one, and multiple third-party entry states addressed by notice requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011–FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “white” defined as an exact rendered value rather than a relative or inherited role? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the distinction between homepage presentation and brand-specific guideline presentation unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “not focusable while hidden” distinct from the visible keyboard reveal and subsequent action-focus sequence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the generic notice copy exact, including its marker and punctuation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “detailed vendor-boundary wording remains intact” scoped to guideline routes, structured data, and metadata? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the fixed-card geometry and no-layout-shift requirements remain consistent with the full-content and positive-bottom-spacing requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Do hidden-action requirements align with the pointer and keyboard reveal requirements without creating an unreachable control? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Do uniform white-copy requirements remain compatible with permitted dark governed surfaces and the shared fallback? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the generic homepage disclosure and detailed route-level disclosure requirements avoid contradictory copy ownership? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-015]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can white copy, target size, contrast, focus visibility, bottom clearance, and layout shift each be measured objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003–SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Can notice cardinality, exact copy, applicability, and association be evaluated independently for zero and positive applicability? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the no-identity-change boundary measurable through source and generated-route evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-008]

## Edge Case and Non-Functional Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are long copy, two stacked 44-pixel actions, narrow widths, and 200 percent zoom addressed without truncation or smaller targets? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004, §FR-010, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK019 Are focus, active, hover, dismissed, closed-disclosure, and reduced-motion states all covered by accessibility requirements independent of color or animation? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-006–FR-010, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the static public-surface security and tenancy boundary explicit enough to avoid inventing authentication, storage, or tenant requirements while preserving destination safety? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies and Scope

- [ ] CHK021 Are the generated registry, existing two-action model, native disclosures, and complete publication pipeline documented as dependencies rather than reimplemented features? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencies, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK022 Are #193, #202, #204, identity asset changes, detailed vendor-copy rewrites, generated outputs, and release publication explicitly excluded? [Scope, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
